hero.heading: Build. Learn. Fly.
hero.lead: Aero Makers at Georgia Tech fosters an technical, friendly environment where all students on campus can connect with the broader aerospace manufacturing community through hands-on projects, workshops, and shared equipment.
hero.image_alt: AMGT members building an RC aircraft together

welcome.heading: Making aerospace accessible to everyone on campus
welcome.description: AMGT bridges the gap between classroom theory and real engineering. We run events that teach members how to make things and invest in equipment that benefits aerospace maker projects across Georgia Tech. That way, students can focus on their ideas instead of worrying on the cost of getting the tools to build their ideas.

events.heading: Learn by doing
events.lead: From build workshops to social events, our events give every student a chance to get hands-on with real aerospace engineering.

hero.heading: Learn by doing (and having fun!)
hero.lead: From free workshops learning to use advanced fabrication equipment to fun social mixers, our events give every student a chance to get their hands on real aerospace engineering and form a team that supports them.

hero.heading: Tools that push what GT makers can build
hero.lead: We purchase and maintain equipment that directly supports aerospace maker projects on campus—helping student teams move faster from idea to flight-ready hardware.

hero.heading: Our mission & team
hero.lead: We foster an inclusive, friendly environment between students and the larger aerospace community through hands-on project workshops, social events, and shared equipment.
hero.image_alt: The Aero Maker Space with equipment and active projects

mission.heading: Making aerospace accessible to everyone on campus
mission.description: AMGT exists to bridge the gap between classroom theory and real engineering. We run events that teach members how to make things, meet others with similar passions, and we invest in equipment that benefits aerospace maker projects across Georgia Tech.
mission.description2: Whether you're prototyping a drone, machining a bracket, starting a club, or interested in  learning a new fabrication skill for the first time, you'll find a welcoming community ready to help you push the bounds of what can be created.
